subject: Uptown Inn — late arrivals, suite staging, and preflight manifest
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sally Carroll <sally.carroll@uptowninn.com>, Tara Singh <tara@acmebio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Uptown Inn — late arrivals, suite staging, and preflight manifest

Sally / Tara —

Thanks again for holding space for our executive workshop the week of July 12. A few items we need your team to confirm so our attendees (many arriving on red-eye flights) have a smooth check-in and immediate quiet workspace: 

1) Late arrivals: we have ~10 guests arriving between 11:30pm–2:00am on July 12/13. Can the front desk provide express arrival packets (room keys + welcome letter) so they don’t have to wait?

2) Suite staging: we need two adjacent executive suites as temporary staging rooms (for AV techs and small prep) from July 12–13, daytime only. These do not need full housekeeping service but should have power strips and a 6-foot table.

3) Master bill & express check-out: we will do a consolidated master bill for conference charges (meals + meeting room) and will require an express check-out option tied to the master bill for room charges. Please confirm the billing contact and whether we can pre-authorize incidentals on a corporate card.

4) Accessibility & sleep needs: several execs have mattress/firmness preferences and one requires roll-in shower access. I’ve attached the guest_manifest_v1.csv with names and baseline preferences. We’ll follow up with any medical docs separately if needed.

5) Arrival point & shuttle: airport pickup will be coordinated by AcmeBio for key VIPs; for the rest, can you share the hotel loading/unloading window for the coach on July 12 (we plan two waves)?

Attachments: guest_manifest_v1.csv

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday (Jun 16) so we can lock travel for the remaining attendees?

Appreciate it —
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Strategic Programs, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Sally Carroll <sally.carroll@uptowninn.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara@acmebio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Uptown Inn — late arrivals, suite staging, and preflight manifest

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the details and the manifest — this is doable. Quick answers below and a few follow-ups: 

- Late arrivals: we can prepare express arrival packets and hold them at the front desk under each guest name. For guests arriving after midnight we’ll put a note on the door with the packet location.

- Suite staging: we have two adjacent junior suites on the 8th floor that we can reserve daytime (7am–6pm) on July 12 and 13. We’ll stock them with power strips and set up a 6-foot table. No housekeeping unless requested.

- Master bill: we can put food & beverage and meeting-room charges on a master account. For room charges, our policy requires a pre-authorization for incidentals. If you want us to waive incidentals and charge room rates to master, we’ll need a signed authorization form. I’ve attached the current room_block_layout.pdf showing the proposed allocation.

- Accessibility: we’ve noted one roll-in shower requirement; please mark that guest as priority for the accessible room.

- Shuttle/loading: coach loading is available at the north porte-cochere between 10:00–11:00 and 16:00–17:00 on July 12. If you have an earlier coach, we can open the lane by 08:30 with prior notice.

Two quick asks from us: can you provide final room assignment confirmations by July 1, and can AcmeBio confirm which VIPs require dedicated airport pick-up?

Best,
Sally Carroll
Senior Events Manager — Uptown Inn
sally.carroll@uptowninn.com | +1 206-555-0124

Attachment: room_block_layout.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sally Carroll <sally.carroll@uptowninn.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Uptown Inn — late arrivals, suite staging, and preflight manifest

Sally —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side after reviewing the proposed layout: 

- Room assignments: we’ll finalize names but want to hold 3 corner suites as quiet rooms for senior execs (no roll-away beds). Please keep those on the 9th floor if possible.

- Dietary / welcome kits: attached is an updated column in the guest manifest for dietary flags (vegetarian, pescatarian, gluten-free). Can the welcome packet include a small snack (granola + fruit) and a printed dietary note for F&B to reference?

- Keycards: for the express packets can you program single-night access that expires at 11:59pm the night after check-in? That reduces night-staff handling.

- Security: Michael will reach out separately about an on-site roster for security check-in; for now please note that two attendees will require temporary escort passes for off-hours building access.

Attachment: guest_manifest_v1.csv (updated)

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Executive Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0277

All good — I signed the DocuSign this morning and billed incidentals per Sally’s authorization template. Confirmed notes:

- DocuSign completed: master-bill authorization signed (see link in Marissa's email).
- Suite staging: 2 junior suites reserved on the 8th floor (July 12–13, 7am–6pm) with power strips & table.

Rafael
